name: apiary-mcp-connector
description: Read-only Apiary cluster state: VM and jail inventory and cluster health, through the Apiary read-only MCP connector.

interface.longDescription: Inspect Apiary VM and jail inventory and summarized cluster health. This connector exposes no mutation tools and requires an Apiary Viewer API key.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me the current Apiary inventory and cluster health.
